comments.comment: The cart total is read before the discount lock is taken, so two concurrent checkouts can apply one coupon twice.
The refund handler writes the full card number into the application log.
The pagination offset multiplies the page number without subtracting one, so the first page of orders is never shown.
The migration deletes the archived ledger rows instead of moving them to the archive table.
No test covers the archive endpoint when the ledger is empty.
